verdict.rationale: Automatic type inference for component props and events is a fair TypeScript DX question for a React framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents prop or event type inference. One community comment calls Next.js a "great isomorphic TS framework," but it does not address inferring component prop or event types without annotations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic type inference for component props and emitted events without writing extra type annotations
